My path analysis results saying that it ended after 7 iterations.

fitUS1 <-lavaan::sem(pathUS,data=us, estimator="ml")
summary(fitUS1, fit.measures=TRUE)

lavaan 0.6-12 ended normally after 7 iterations

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: Increase iterations
parts:
lavaan ended after 7 iterations because convergence was achieved. Solution "found" (though can be at a local minima).

May I know why you want to increase the number of iterations? A small number of iterations per se is not necessarily a bad thing.

-- Shu Fai
